anwg_definition.completion_dependence: completed requests receive possible numerator credit; dropped/unfinished requests receive zero numerator credit and remain in the denominator
anwg_definition.denominator: sum_i w_i over all arriving requests passed via all_requests
anwg_definition.horizon_dependence: unfinished/dropped requests at terminal evaluation count as zero; if continuation drains all work before deadlines, ANWG can saturate at one
anwg_definition.latency_dependence: binary only through whether completion_time <= slo_deadline; no continuous latency sensitivity once deadlines are met
anwg_definition.normalization: arrival-normalized by total arriving request weight, not only completed request weight
anwg_definition.queueing_dependence: indirect only if queueing causes missed deadlines or unfinished requests
anwg_definition.terminal_state_dependence: computed from completed and dropped requests at continuation termination
anwg_definition.tpOT_dependence: none except through deadline miss or unfinished work
anwg_definition.ttft_dependence: none except through deadline miss or unfinished work
anwg_definition.when_equals_one: all positive-weight arriving requests complete and every completion_time is <= slo_deadline
